subject.title: fix(agent): stale replies after queued user turns

question: Should OpenClaw land this preserve-as-context metadata-walk repair as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/76888, prefer the stale-internal-drop semantics from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96533, or request a combined repair?
rationale: Both open PRs target the same stale-reply root cause but encode different provider-visible session-state semantics, and automation should not choose that product contract by itself.

options.title: Accept preserve-as-context
options.body: Land this PR after maintainer signoff and exact-head validation if older queued user text should remain provider-visible as context while the latest active prompt stays the answer target.

options.title: Prefer stale-internal-drop
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96533 as the canonical path if selected internal orphan prompts should be removed rather than preserved in provider-visible context.

options.title: Request a combined repair
options.body: Ask for one narrow update that combines this PR’s metadata walk with explicit provenance-aware drop/preserve semantics and proof before either branch lands.

recommendation.title: Accept preserve-as-context
recommendation.body: Land this PR after maintainer signoff and exact-head validation if older queued user text should remain provider-visible as context while the latest active prompt stays the answer target.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the active-turn queued-user prompt preservation invariant introduced in the feature history.
